data.name: Shivansh
data.gender_notes: Shivansh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śiva, 'Shiva', + aṃśa, 'part' — 'a part of Shiva'. Its root is Sanskrit śiva + aṃśa. A modern devotional name. Shivansh is a Sanskrit name meaning “A part of Shiva”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shivansh expresses “A part of Shiva”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śiva, 'Shiva', + aṃśa, 'part' — 'a part of Shiva'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivansh total 37, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
